Watched live alert precision against confirmed failures in the weekly review with the maintenance planners, and handled production model incidents including two sensor feed drop-outs, with incident records in the platform incident log. (src_142b77c79acc)
Built and backtested each model on historical sensor and work‑order data under the evaluation protocol agreed with the planners before proposing it for release. (src_fdede1e29daf)
Coordinated model releases with the platform team in the release review, recording in the release ticket which checks were mine and which belonged to the platform team. (src_94179080c6e8)

Wrote the model card for each model, listing the training data window, the backtest results, the known limitations for turbines without vibration sensors and the hand‑over conditions. (src_6cbd112fa085)
